ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows a topographic profile along the Tropic, with sea area e on the left side and sea area f on the right side; in the land part, on the west side near around 70° there is a very high mountain peak b, on the east side around about 50° there is a lower highland d, and in the middle there is lowland c. Based on the longitudes 70°, 60°, 50° and the feature of the tall mountain range on the west side, it can be judged that this profile is a profile of South America near along the Tropic of Capricorn, the tall mountain range on the west side corresponds to the Andes Mountains, e is located in the Pacific Ocean on the west side of South America, and f is located in the Atlantic Ocean on the east side of South America. Then reason: sea area e on the west coast of South America is affected by the Peru Cold Current, the seawater temperature is relatively low, evaporation is relatively weak, and salinity is relatively low; sea area f on the east coast is affected by the warmer Brazil Warm Current, the seawater temperature is relatively high, evaporation is relatively strong, and salinity is relatively high. Therefore, the salinity of sea area e is lower than the salinity of sea area f.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below is a “schematic diagram of a topographic profile of a certain region along the Tropic.”

<image1>

Based on the diagram, compare the salinity relationship between sea area e and sea area f (expressed using Se and Sf).

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: e is the sea west of the continental profile, f is the sea east of it, with an Andes-like high peak on the western side and longitudes around 70°–50°. Identify the section as South America along the Tropic of Capricorn. Then use the current effect: e is on the cold-current Pacific coast, f is on the warmer Atlantic coast. Cold current/low evaporation at e gives lower salinity than the warmer, more evaporative Atlantic side at f, so conclude Se<Sf.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是沿回归线的地形剖面，左侧为 e 海域，右侧为 f 海域；陆地部分西侧靠近 70°附近有很高的山峰 b，东侧约 50°附近有较低高地 d，中间有低地 c。根据经度 70°、60°、50°及西侧高大山脉特征，可判断该剖面为南美洲沿南回归线附近的剖面，西侧高大山脉对应安第斯山脉，e 位于南美西侧太平洋，f 位于南美东侧大西洋。再推理：南美西岸 e 海域受秘鲁寒流影响，海水温度较低，蒸发较弱，盐度相对较低；东岸 f 海域受较暖的巴西暖流影响，海水温度较高，蒸发较强，盐度相对较高。因此 e 海域盐度低于 f 海域盐度。
